decisions.reason: As a recently launched display close to the core offer and already given its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and sunk development effort, so management is likely to continue with it.

This product sits squarely within the firm's established cardboard display business and has been publicly presented, which under escalation of commitment makes withdrawal unlikely after only a short time on the market.
Although it overlaps with the firm's existing display range, the recent launch and clear public commitment make management more inclined to justify and persist with it than to remove it quickly.

Even if the eighth-pallet format may serve a narrower niche, it is still close to the core business and visibly launched, so management would likely keep it and attribute any weak early uptake to temporary market factors.

This wooden display pallet is a somewhat greater step from the firm's paper-centered base, but because it still builds on the established display offer and has been openly marketed, management is still more likely to persist than to exit.
The product remains closely tied to the firm's established quarter-pallet display capabilities and its public launch creates justification pressure, so management is likely to retain it for now.
